signal: Archway enhanced its investment operations platform through a strategic partnership with Canoe Intelligence to automate alternative-asset data

email.body1:
Richard, saw Archway enhance the platform through the Canoe Intelligence partnership on alternative-asset data.

A platform move like that usually opens more in-market asset managers and family offices than the team can personally cover, and uncovered accounts are where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Archway off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Richard, quick follow-up for Archway.

As the platform expands, the revenue target usually grows faster than you can staff for. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Archway needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Richard, last bit of proof for Archway.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Archway's reply rate likely compares to other fintech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Richard, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up a new platform partnership is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a fintech motion? I will tailor it to Archway either way.
